title: Puthoff visited Ossining and heard about the Nine

tellings.quote: Puthoff tells us that he went to Puharich's house in Ossining, heard all about the nine,

plain: A researcher called Greg, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the physicist Hal Puthoff told them he went to the house of the researcher Andrija Puharich in Ossining, New York, in the 1970s. There, Greg says, Puthoff heard all about "the Nine", a council of non-human beings that Puharich's circle claimed to be in contact with, and the story also involves Puthoff's research partner Russell Targ. If true, it would link serious government-funded scientists to that circle's contact claims.
